name: ASRock Phantom Gaming PG27QFT2A

Gigabyte site blocked direct fetch; values via search snippets of official pages.

name: LG UltraGear 27GS75Q-B

name: BenQ EW270Q
notes: Matte coating, Flicker-free, Low Blue Light Plus. 1x HDMI 2.0, 1x DP 1.4, 1x USB-C (DP Alt, 65W PD). 4.64 kg with base. Built-in PSU. Per-input refresh not published; HDMI 2.0 likely limited below 200 Hz (unconfirmed). Flatness inferred.

name: KTC M27T6S (Mini-LED)

Integrated PSU per DisplayNinja; KTC support page lists 100-240V. Typical SDR brightness spec not found (measured ~626 nits SDR). Weight without stand not found (listings give 6.55-7 kg, unclear).
